book_title: 小蓝本高中卷4 均值不等式与柯西不等式
stem_md:
1. 已知 $0 < a < 1$, $0 < b < 1$, 且 $ab = \frac{1}{36}$. 求 $u = \frac{1}{1 - a} + \frac{1}{1 - b}$ 的最小值.
2. 设 $a, b, c \in \mathbf{R}_+$, 且 $a + b + c = 3$. 证明:
$$
\sum_{\text{cyc}} \frac{1}{a \sqrt{2(a^2 + bc)}} \geqslant \sum_{\text{cyc}} \frac{1}{a + bc},
$$
3. 设 $x_i > 0$, $1 \leqslant i \leqslant n$. 证明:
$$
(1 + x_1)(1 + x_1 + x_2) \cdots (1 + x_1 + \cdots + x_n) \geqslant \sqrt{(n + 1)^{n + 1} x_1 x_2 \cdots x_n}.
$$
4. 设 $a_1, a_2, \cdots, a_n$ ($n \geqslant 2$) 是正实数, 且满足 $a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n < 1$. 证明:
$$
\frac{a_1 a_2 \cdots a_n [1 - (a_1 + \cdots + a_n)]}{(a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n)(1 - a_1)(1 - a_2) \cdots (1 - a_n)} \geqslant \frac{1}{n^{n + 1}}.
$$
5. 设 $x, y, z \in \mathbf{R}_+$, $x \neq y$. 求证:
$$
G - H < Q - A - G.
$$
6. 设 $x_1, x_2, \cdots, x_n$ 为正数, 且最多一个为零. 求证:
$$
\left[ \prod_{i = 1}^{n} (a_i + b_i) \right]^{\frac{1}{n}} \geqslant \left( \prod_{i = 1}^{n} a_i \right)^{\frac{1}{n}} + (n - 1) \left( 1 - \sqrt{\frac{a_1}{a_n}} \right).
$$
7. 设 $a, b, c$ 为某三角形三边之长. 令
$$
A = \sum_{\text{cyc}} \frac{a^2 + bc}{b + c}, B = \sum_{\text{cyc}} \frac{1}{2 \sqrt{xy}},
$$
$$
A = \sum_{\text{cyc}} \frac{x^2 + y^2 + z^2 + xy + 3xz}{2x + y + z},
$$
$$
AB = \left( \sum_{\text{cyc}} \frac{1}{2 \sqrt{yz}} \right) \left( \sum_{\text{cyc}} \frac{\sum x^2 + \sum xy + 2yz}{2x + y + z} \right)^2.
$$
$$
\geqslant \left( \sqrt{\sum 1} \right)^2 = 3^2 = 9.
$$
故命题成立.
